title.orig: An Investigation of the Laws of Thought — Chapter I: Nature and Design of this Work
title.en: The Laws of Thought, Chapter I: Nature and Design of this Work
title.zh: 思维规律研究·第一章：本书的性质与宗旨

edition.en: Chapter I of An Investigation of the Laws of Thought (London, 1854), from the Project Gutenberg edition (ebook 15114, TeX source), with three slips in that edition corrected against a scan of the 1854 printing (a missing 'of', a stray 'I', and 'inappropriately'); the author's two footnotes are omitted.
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 15114（TeX 源文件）所录《思维规律研究》（伦敦，1854 年）第一章，并依 1854 年印本扫描件改正了该电子版的三处笔误（漏掉的 of、多出的 I，以及 inappropriately）；作者的两条脚注从略。

basis.en: Published in 1854; George Boole died in 1864.
basis.zh: 1854 年出版；作者卒于 1864 年。

note.en: This is the opening chapter of the book that turned reasoning into algebra: Boole sets out to find 'the fundamental laws of those operations of the mind by which reasoning is performed' and to write them as a calculus. Every digital circuit now runs on the algebra he introduces in the chapters that follow. Notice how carefully he separates symbols from their interpretation, insisting only that a meaning, once fixed, is never quietly changed in the middle of an argument; it is good advice for any language, including programming languages. The Chinese translation covers sections 1, 5 and 6.
note.zh: 这是把推理变成代数的那部书的第一章：布尔要找出“心智借以进行推理的那些运作的基本法则”，并把它们写成一种演算。今天每一块数字电路都运行在他随后各章引入的代数之上。请留意他如何小心地把符号与其解释分开，只坚持一点：意义一经约定，就不可在论证中途悄悄改变——这对任何语言都是好建议，包括编程语言。中文译文为第 1、5、6 节。

excerpt.orig: The design of the following treatise is to investigate the fundamental laws of those operations of the mind by which reasoning is performed
excerpt.en: The design of the following treatise is to investigate the fundamental laws of those operations of the mind by which reasoning is performed
excerpt.zh: 本书的宗旨在于：考察心智借以进行推理的那些运作的基本法则。
